parsed.name: Cytomat 自动化孵育存储柜
parsed.description: 一种用于微孔板（MTP）自动化存储与孵育的立式设备。包含可开关的舱门、内部货架/存储位、传输站（transfer station）和可伸缩的取放装置（铲/移载机构），并配有条码读取、摇床（振荡器）以及温度、CO₂、湿度和 O₂ 等环境传感与控制能力，常用于自动化实验室中板材的存取、临时暴露以及长期孵育保存。
parsed.description_en: A vertical automated plate hotel/incubator for microplates (MTP). The unit provides door-controlled compartments, stacked storage racks, a transfer station for external robots, and an internal shuttle/shovel mechanism to move plates between storage, wait and exposed positions. It typically includes barcode reading, shaker modules, and environmental sensors/controls for temperature, CO2, humidity and O2 for automated storage and incubation workflows.

actions.description: 将设备外部暴露位的微孔板移回指定储存位，放置后移动到等待位并关闭门。
actions.description_en: Move an MTP from the exposed (external) position back into a specified storage location, then move to the wait position and close the door.

actions.description: 将暴露位的微孔板移回设备内部的等待位并关闭门。
actions.description_en: Return an MTP from the exposed position to the internal wait position and close the door.

actions.description: 读取指定存储位置（或两个位置）的条形码信息。
actions.description_en: Read the barcode(s) of specified storage location(s).

actions.description: 从储存位取出微孔板并将其运输到设备外部的暴露位供取用。
actions.description_en: Retrieve an MTP from storage and transport it to the exposed position outside the device.

actions.description: 从储存位取出微孔板，打开门并放置到传输站（transfer station），随后关闭门。
actions.description_en: Retrieve an MTP from storage, open the door and place it onto the transfer station, then close the door.

actions.description: 从储存位取出微孔板并移动到内部的等待位。
actions.description_en: Retrieve an MTP from storage and move it to the internal wait position.

actions.description: 从传输站取回载板，打开门并将其放入指定储存位，然后关门。
actions.description_en: Open the lift/door, pick up a plate from the transfer station and place it into a specified storage location, then close the door.

actions.description: 从传输站取回微孔板并将其带回到内部等待位，随后关闭门。
actions.description_en: Retrieve an MTP from the transfer station, return it to the internal wait position, and close the door.

actions.description: 将等待位的微孔板移动到设备外部的暴露位以便外部取用。
actions.description_en: Move an MTP from the internal wait position to the exposed (external) position for external access.

actions.description: 把等待位的微孔板放入指定的储存位，然后返回等待位。
actions.description_en: Move an MTP from the wait position into a specified storage location, then return to the wait position.

actions.description: 打开门并将等待位的微孔板放到传输站，然后返回等待位并关闭门。
actions.description_en: Open the door, place the plate from the wait position onto the transfer station, return to wait position, and close the door.

actions.description: 关闭孵育柜或货舱的门。
actions.description_en: Close the incubator/storage door.

actions.description: 将指定的微孔板移动到装载托盘或外部上料托盘位置以供取放。
actions.description_en: Move a specified plate to the loading tray or external loading position for pickup.

actions.description: 初始化设备内的振荡/摇床模块以准备工作。
actions.description_en: Initialize the internal shaker modules to prepare them for operation.

actions.description: 对设备执行初始化准备（例如复位、回原点并准备接收命令）。
actions.description_en: Initialize and prepare the Cytomat for operation (e.g., reset, home axes, clear preconditions).

actions.description: 打开孵育柜或货舱的门以便交互或放取微孔板。
actions.description_en: Open the incubator/storage door to allow interaction or plate transfer.

actions.description: 清除或重置设备的错误寄存器/错误状态。
actions.description_en: Reset or clear the device error register / error state.

actions.description: 发送动作命令并在超时时间内等待完成，返回概览寄存器状态。
actions.description_en: Send an action command, wait (with timeout) for completion, and return the overview register state.

actions.description: 发送低级命令到设备并处理重试与响应（包含错误与忙碌重试机制）。
actions.description_en: Send a low-level command to the device and handle retries and responses (including busy/recognition retries).

actions.description: 导出或序列化设备当前配置/状态以便传输或记录。
actions.description_en: Serialize or export the device's current configuration/state for transmission or recording.

actions.description: 设置或定义设备内部的货架/储存位布局与配置。
actions.description_en: Set or define the internal rack/storage location layout and configuration.

actions.description: 为一个或多个振荡模块设置振荡频率。
actions.description_en: Set the shaking frequency for one or more shaker modules.

actions.description: 设置 孵育温度
actions.description_en: set incubation temperature

actions.description: 执行设备启动准备（配置运行所需的初始状态和参数）。
actions.description_en: Perform device setup to prepare initial state and parameters for operation.

actions.description: 将内部铲/取放臂伸入设备以进行抓取或放置操作（进仓动作）。
actions.description_en: Move the internal shovel/shuttle into the device to pick or place plates (ingress action).

actions.description: 将内部铲/取放臂移出到可访问位置以便外部取放（出仓动作）。
actions.description_en: Move the internal shovel/shuttle out to an accessible position for external pickup or placement (egress action).

actions.description: 启动振荡/摇床（按指定频率和可选的振荡模块）。
actions.description_en: Start shaking on the shaker(s) at a specified frequency (optionally for selected shaker units).

actions.description: 停止当前运行的任务或中断正在进行的动作（安全停止）。
actions.description_en: Stop the current running task or abort an ongoing action (safe stop).

actions.description: 停止一个或多个振荡模块的振荡动作。
actions.description_en: Stop shaking on one or more shaker modules.

actions.description: 接收来自外部的微孔板并将其放置到指定的设备内部位置（入库）。
actions.description_en: Accept a plate from an external source and place it into a specified internal location (take-in).

actions.description: 等待设备当前任务完成（监控概览寄存器直到非忙碌或超时）。
actions.description_en: Wait for the device's current task to complete (monitor the overview register until not busy or timeout).

actions.description: 等待传输站达到期望状态：占用或空闲。
actions.description_en: Wait until the transfer station reaches the desired state: occupied or unoccupied.

actions.description: 获取 概览寄存器（设备总体状态）
actions.description_en: get overview register (summary of device status)

actions.description: 获取 警告寄存器（当前警告信息）
actions.description_en: get warning register (current warnings)

actions.description: 获取 错误寄存器（当前错误或故障代码）
actions.description_en: get error register (current errors/fault codes)

actions.description: 获取 操作寄存器（当前或最近动作的状态）
actions.description_en: get action register (status of current or recent actions)

actions.description: 获取 交换寄存器（与移载/交换相关的状态位）
actions.description_en: get swap register (state bits related to swapping/transfer operations)

actions.description: 获取 传感器寄存器（原始传感器状态/输入）
actions.description_en: get sensor register (raw sensor states/inputs)

actions.description: 获取 指定的孵育查询项（请求某一孵育相关值或状态）
actions.description_en: get a specified incubation query value or status

actions.description: 获取 CO2 浓度读数
actions.description_en: get CO2 concentration

actions.description: 获取 湿度读数
actions.description_en: get humidity

actions.description: 获取 O2（氧气）浓度读数
actions.description_en: get O2 concentration

actions.description: 获取 孵育温度
actions.description_en: get incubation temperature
